cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial screen renders with the card-number prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. Operator signed on; the Card View (DB2) screen is opened fresh from the Main Menu (transaction OD03).
cases.steps:
1. Select the Card View (DB2) function from the Main Menu (OCMENU)
2. Observe the opening screen
cases.expected: The header line shows Tran 「OD03」, program 「ODCARDV」, the title 「ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM」, plus the current date and time. Only the Card Num field is enterable; Acct ID, Name, Expiry and Status are shown as empty. The message line shows 「Enter card number and press ENTER.」 and the function-key legend reads 「ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear」.
cases.remark: M1 (WS-PROGRAM initial) · 1000-SEND-INITIAL L52-63 · map MCARDVA / mapset MCARDV · WHEAD WS-HDR-TITLE · EIBCALEN=0 path L39

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Cursor starts in Card Num; detail fields are display-only
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Card View (DB2) screen is just opened (initial prompt shown).
cases.steps:
1. Observe where the cursor rests on the opening screen
2. Try to move into the Acct ID / Name / Expiry / Status fields
cases.expected: The cursor rests in the Card Num field (initial focus). The Acct ID, Name, Expiry and Status fields are display-only and cannot be typed into; they are empty until a card is looked up.
cases.remark: CARDNUM attr UNPROT/IC/FSET (IC = initial cursor) · detail fields ASKIP · §2 item states (all detail = □)

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Header date and time are formatted with the expected separators
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Card View (DB2) screen is open.
cases.steps: 1. Read the Date and Time fields in the header line
cases.expected: The Date field shows the current date with hyphen separators (e.g. 2026-09-28) and the Time field shows the current time with colon separators (e.g. 14:30:05). Tran shows 「OD03」 and program shows 「ODCARDV」.
cases.remark: 8500-GET-DATE-TIME · CICS ASKTIME/FORMATTIME DATESEP('-') TIMESEP(':') L164-176 · date NOT from OUDATE (no CALL/LINK)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Look up an active card and display its details
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4000000000000001 exists (JOHN Q SMITH, active).
cases.steps:
1. Type 4000000000000001 into the Card Num field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The card is looked up and its details are shown: Acct ID 00000000001, Name JOHN Q SMITH, Expiry 2027-03-31, Status Y. The message line shows 「Card displayed.」. The CVV is not shown anywhere.
cases.remark: M2 · 2100-READ-AND-SHOW REC-FOUND L93-96 · 3000 SELECT ORION.CARD SQLCODE 0 · 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL · acct CD-ACCT-ID 9(11) zero-padded

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: An inactive card is displayed too (no active-status gate)
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4000000000000003 exists (ROBERT B JOHNSON) and its status is N (inactive).
cases.steps:
1. Type 4000000000000003 into the Card Num field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The card is shown with Acct ID 00000000003, Name ROBERT B JOHNSON, Expiry 2026-01-31 and Status N. The read-only view displays the inactive card normally — it is not blocked or hidden. The message line shows 「Card displayed.」.
cases.remark: M2 · classifier CD-ACTIVE-STATUS = N · no status check in 4000-POPULATE-DETAIL (status moved as-is)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Consecutive lookups in one session (pseudo-conversational)
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4000000000000001 has just been displayed on the screen.
cases.steps:
1. Overtype the Card Num field with 4000000000000002
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Without returning to the menu, the second card is looked up and its details replace the first: Acct ID 00000000002, Name MARIA A GARCIA, Expiry 2028-06-30, Status Y, message 「Card displayed.」.
cases.remark: pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID OD03 · commarea re-enter path (CA-PGM-CONTEXT=1) → 2000-PROCESS-INPUT → ENTER

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the screen back to the prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. A card (4000000000000001) is currently displayed with its details.
cases.expected: The entered value and displayed details are cleared and the screen returns to the opening state: only Card Num enterable, message line 「Enter card number and press ENTER.」.

cases.name: PF3 returns to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Card View (DB2) screen is open.
cases.expected: The transaction transfers control to the Main Menu (OCMENU); the Card View screen is left.
cases.remark: 状態遷移/連携 · 2000 WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU → XCTL PROGRAM(OCMENU) L67-68,136-144

cases.name: Re-entry with first-enter context shows the prompt again
cases.precondition: F-STD. The transaction is re-invoked carrying a first-enter context (as when re-selected from the menu), rather than a cold start.
cases.steps:
1. Re-enter the Card View (DB2) function so it arrives with the first-enter context
2. Observe the screen
cases.expected: The opening prompt is shown again exactly as on a cold start: only Card Num enterable, message line 「Enter card number and press ENTER.」.
cases.remark: M1 · 0000-MAIN ELSE branch WHEN CA-FIRST-ENTER → 1000-SEND-INITIAL L42-45

cases.mid: 権限・セキュリティ (Authority / security)
cases.name: CVV is never displayed on the view
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4000000000000004 exists (LINDA C WILLIAMS) with a stored CVV of 456.
cases.steps:
1. Type 4000000000000004 into the Card Num field
2. Press ENTER
3. Inspect every field on the screen
cases.expected: The screen shows Card Num, Acct ID 00000000004, Name LINDA C WILLIAMS, Expiry 2029-11-30 and Status Y, but there is no CVV field and the value 456 appears nowhere. Any signed-on operator may view the card (no per-role restriction in the program).
cases.remark: security-by-omission: SELECT reads only acct/name/expiry/status (CD-CVV not selected) L118 · no CA-USER-TYPE gate

cases.name: Blank Card Num with ENTER is rejected as required
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Card View (DB2) screen is open with the Card Num field left empty.
cases.steps:
1. Leave the Card Num field blank
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: No lookup is performed; the message line shows 「Please enter all required fields.」 and the screen stays on Card View for a fresh entry.
cases.remark: M5 · 2100 IF CARDNUMI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES → WS-MSG-REQUIRED L86-88

cases.name: Free-format card number accepted (no format check) then not found
cases.precondition: F-STD. No card key equal to ABCD012345678901 exists.
cases.steps:
1. Type ABCD012345678901 (a 16-character non-numeric value) into the Card Num field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The value is accepted without any format complaint (the field applies no numeric/format rule), the card is looked up and, finding no match, the message line shows 「Record not found.」.
cases.remark: no picin on CARDNUM (X(16), free format) · 3000 SELECT SQLCODE 100 → M6 · demonstrates absence of format validation

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: A non-existent card number reports not found
cases.precondition: F-STD. No card with key 4000000000000009 exists.
cases.steps:
1. Type 4000000000000009 into the Card Num field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The lookup returns no row; the message line shows 「Record not found.」 and the detail fields stay empty. (A genuine table read error would surface the same 「Record not found.」 — the 「Error reading card table.」 text is set but overwritten before display, so it is never seen.)
cases.remark: M6 · 2100 ELSE REC-NOT-FOUND → WS-MSG-NOTFND L97-98 · 3000 SQLCODE 100 (and OTHER) · M3 dead (overwritten) — see NOTES

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unsupported function key is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Card View (DB2) screen is open.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF5 (a key the screen does not support)
cases.expected: Pressing PF5 (an unsupported key) leaves the screen on Card View and the message line shows 「Invalid key pressed. Please try again.」; no lookup is performed.

cases.name: Full 16-character key (max length) matches and displays
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4000000000000005 exists (DAVID D BROWN, active).
cases.steps:
1. Type the full 16-character value 4000000000000005 into the Card Num field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The exact 16-character key matches; the card is shown with Acct ID 00000000005, Name DAVID D BROWN, Expiry 2030-05-31, Status Y and message 「Card displayed.」.
cases.remark: 境界値 upper · CARDNUM/CD-NUM X(16) exact 16-char key · SQLCODE 0

cases.name: 15-character partial key (one below full) is not found
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4000000000000005 exists; no key equal to the 15-character prefix exists.
cases.steps:
1. Type the 15-character prefix 400000000000000 into the Card Num field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The short entry is right-padded with a space to 16 characters, so it does not equal any stored 16-character key; the message line shows 「Record not found.」.
cases.remark: 境界値 just-below-max · X(16) space padding → key mismatch → SQLCODE 100 → M6

cases.name: Single-character key (minimum non-blank) is not found
cases.precondition: F-STD. No card whose key is a single 4 padded with spaces exists.
cases.steps:
1. Type a single character 4 into the Card Num field
2. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The single character passes the required-field check (it is not blank) but, padded to 16 characters, matches no stored key; the message line shows 「Record not found.」.
cases.remark: 境界値 lower (1 char, distinct from blank/M5) · not blank → past L86 → SELECT SQLCODE 100 → M6
